travel.title: City Travel Guides: Arrivals, Transport & Itineraries
travel.intro: Plan the first journey before filling the whole day. Start with an airport transfer, choose a manageable itinerary, or compare a rail trip with the time you will actually have at the destination. Each guide separates published transport information from our suggested planning allowances.

things.title: Things to Do: Markets, Walks & Cultural Visits
things.intro: Choose one anchor for the outing: a market, a neighbourhood walk or a cultural visit. These guides explain arrival choices, booking decisions and shorter alternatives so you can fit a place into the time you have, rather than collect a list of stops.

hotels.title: Bangkok Hotels: Area, Room & Booking Comparisons
hotels.intro: Begin with where you will spend the day and how you will return at night. Our Bangkok hotel guide compares Sukhumvit and riverside planning needs, then examines four riverside properties by location, room category and booking terms. The listings below are research starting points, not personally inspected or scored hotels.
